name: print-social-technology-simplified-webinar-flyer-orange-purple-grid
title: 'Technology Simplified' webinar flyer with an orange-purple grid of flat illustration and abstract tiles
whatItIs: A purple-bordered black flyer with a pill-shaped 'TECHNOLOGY SIMPLIFIED' header, a grid of tiles: a flat illustration of a man checking his phone on orange, two abstract geometric pattern tiles, pink 'Join the Webinar' and yellow date pills, and a bold purple 'Innovate the Future' headline with speaker credit and registration link.
whatItMeans: Organised and modern; treating logistics as grid tiles alongside illustration makes a webinar flyer feel like a tidy dashboard.
techniques: Arrange mixed content types (illustration, pattern, logistics) as grid tiles.
Use pill-shaped tiles for date and action details.
Frame the whole flyer in one bold border colour.

vocabulary.definition: A layout of equal-sized cells each holding different content.
A rounded rectangle used to hold a short piece of information.
